Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Marcos to summon China envoy over use of force ‘threat’

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will summon Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan over a ‘threat’ the envoy had made on the use of force.

items: Ex-Mindanao official linked to multi-million drug operation

blocks.text: Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla links Mindanaoan official Edrieza Nasser Rimbang to a multi-million shabu shipment from Laos bound for Manila.

items: Macacua secures 46-member coalition backing ahead of BARMM chief minister vote

blocks.text: Forty-six members of the newly elected Bangsamoro Parliament signed a coalition agreement, backing interim Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua.

items: Ukraine hits Russian refinery as Zelenskyy says ‘we’re done’ with Trump’s energy truce

blocks.text: Ukraine strikes a Russian oil refinery after President Volodymyr Zelenskyy declared Kyiv was abandoning a ceasefire announced by US President Donald Trump.

items: ‘No person is walang kwenta’: Groups, friends defend Josh Aquino amid podcast controversy

blocks.text: The National Bureau of Investigation is set to probe the hosts of ‘Machong Chismisan’ after the public backlash over offensive remarks mocking Kris Aquino’s son, Josh. – Rappler.com
